content:
An illustrated guide to restoring a)—what?—some flowers soon? or b) an errorless Internet (somewhere where living together is) or c) a pathology of forgetting machines or d) an imaginary garden with real networks in it, or e) a herbal of exsanguine causes or f) an intersubjective encyclopedia or g) an "action désorganisé et plan du monde" or h) an ark for hypercards or i) a returned Promise for what is the opposite of an engineer? or j) an enfilade of hearts or k) a howto for a grammar of 'mixed-analogical reasoning' or l) a zoology of the marked-bad sectors of a knowledge or m) an overload of overloads, in lieu of furies

Open …
